operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers: repair_ID, Launch_Date, Machine_ID, Making_Year, Machine_series, value_points, quality_rank, technician_id, Name, Starting_Year, Age, Class, Team, Notes — must be double-quoted verbatim.
DDL uses backtick-quoted FK refs (`technician`(`technician_id`)) inside CREATE TABLE; sqlite_master text must be replayed as-is.
technician.technician_id declared REAL but stores 1.0,2.0,...; repair_assignment.technician_id declared INT referencing it — FK type mismatch (REAL parent vs INT child).
repair_assignment PK is composite (technician_id, repair_ID, Machine_ID) — all three are also FKs; composite-PK member max_l0=30 path applies.
All tables tiny (9-10 rows); original_values fully read, no sampling needed.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE constraints anywhere; only PKs and FKs.
Launch_Date is TEXT storing 'DD Mon YYYY' (e.g. '21 Jan 2009') — text-stored date, TS String fuzzer, not Date.
Making_Year is INT storing 1991..1995 — declared INT so Number fuzzer, not Year (no 'year' in type string).
Class and Machine_series have distinct=1 ('125cc', 'RS125') — near-constant columns.
Notes has near-duplicate values differing only in case ('repair Failed...' vs 'repair failed...') — case-sensitive distinct.
repair_assignment.technician_id distinct=5 but technician has 10 rows — FK child uses subset of parent keys.
No self-references, no dangling FKs, no views/triggers/indexes beyond PKs.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on repair_ID/Machine_ID/technician_id/repair_assignment.*: scale=0 int, range [-1,1] then +-1/+-2 perturbation — will produce 0, -1, 2, 3 etc., implausible as IDs (FN risk on id=1 filters).

technician_id REAL: Number scale=0 (no args), float perturbation +-0.01/+-0.02 — produces 1.01, 0.99, non-integer IDs; FK child INT draws from these then sqlite affinity coerces — likely FK orphans after coercion (FP risk).
Making_Year INT: Number scale=0 range [-1,1] — produces years like 0, -1, 2, not 1991-1995; any 'Making_Year > 1990' predicate becomes trivially true/false (FN/FP).
value_points REAL: Number scale=0, range [-1,1] — original 57..194; range predicates on value_points almost always false (FN).
quality_rank INT: Number scale=0 [-1,1] — original 1..5; rank comparisons degenerate.
Age INT: Number scale=0 [-1,1] — original 28..43; age filters degenerate.
Starting_Year REAL: Number scale=0 [-1,1] — original 2002..2013; year filters degenerate.
Launch_Date TEXT: String fuzzer, length range from originals (~11), CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() — produces random strings, never 'DD Mon YYYY'; date-format predicates (LIKE '%Jan%', substr) miss (FN).

name/Name/Team/Class/Machine_series/Notes: String fuzzer with contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop) — plausible-ish but random; equality joins on Team ('NYY' vs 'CLE') will not match across tables (FN on cross-table Team joins).
Class/Machine_series distinct=1: String sampler with 5 original draws all '125cc'/'RS125' plus pool; p=0.2 fresh random strings break the constant (FP on 'Class = 125cc' filters).

repair_assignment composite PK: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate triples; with tiny parent pools (9-10) and 3 FK columns, many triples collide and get dropped — instance may shrink drastically (FP from missing rows).

FK child draws from parent FINAL filtered column with replacement: technician_id child (INT) drawing from REAL parent values 1.0..10.0 — sqlite stores as int 1..10, but if parent filtered to few rows, child gets few distinct values (missing ties).
